provenance.authority: Git canonical source + EKB + Supabase governed records

owner_contract.authority_owner: existing governed authority / SUPER_ADMIN only for genuinely required human decisions
owner_contract.specialist_use: CAPABILITY_SELECTOR candidates require consumer-owned admission; no automatic execution
owner_contract.tests_owner: Testing after completion of procedure authoring

steps.procedure: Normalize intent, target, exclusions, expected outcome, declared decision owner and evidence references. Never infer implementation or force Story/Agent Task identity.
steps.guard: Unclear essential intent -> REQUIRES_DECISION; missing exact target -> NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE; no implementation action.

steps.procedure: Derive change type, open target granularity and L1/L2/L3 from existing governed risk/materiality/reversibility signals. Specialist selector lists candidates but does not execute them.
steps.guard: Material unknown -> at least L2 and NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE; L3 high-risk dominates; no weights or case hardcoding.

steps.procedure: Consult EKB and canonical authority first; resolve target, independent AUTHORITY_STATE and IMPLEMENTATION_STATE, current evidence, AS-IS/delta or bounded absence and reuse options; stop at minimum sufficient evidence.
steps.guard: Missing/stale/contradictory material authority -> NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE or BLOCKED; no speculative full search.

steps.procedure: Consume existing transversal impact core and produce analysis projection: direct, indirect, consumers, data, interfaces, lifecycle, permissions and shared dependencies.
steps.guard: Unknown impact is visible, never silently excluded; no new parallel impact engine.

steps.procedure: Preserve facts vs decisions and versioned ADR refs; reuse DECISION_CONTEXT_ASOF/CURRENTNESS_AUTHORITY; request human decision only for genuine material tradeoff or missing active ADR.
steps.guard: Required new ADR or unresolved owner decision -> REQUIRES_DECISION; analysis cannot approve itself; local HOW remains PG-03.

steps.procedure: Emit outcomes, typed requirements, interfaces/states/errors/permissions/side effects, acceptance signals and CANONICAL_IMPLEMENTATION_BINDINGS. Preserve AS-IS/delta for existing implementation and reuse-before-build for new.
steps.guard: Missing material obligation or permission/side effect -> typed blocker on affected scope. Do not choose technology, create tests, write SQL or implement.

steps.procedure: Derive all evidence-backed material fronts from impact, requirements, bindings, decisions, risks and specialist outputs. Emit each once with scope refs, status and evidence/currentness.
steps.guard: Unknown material -> BLOCKED front; NOT_APPLICABLE demands reason+evidence; REUSE_AS_IS demands currentness.

steps.procedure: STOP only if decision stable, all material fronts accounted, no unresolved decision-changing question and no reasonable available evidence would change a material decision.
steps.guard: Material missing -> CONTINUE with targeted return to A3/A4/A5/A6/A7 as indicated; human decision -> REQUIRES_DECISION; impossible material evidence -> BLOCKED. No curiosity loops.

steps.procedure: Assemble lossless package, scope_front_matrix and per-scope readiness; compile PROGRAMMING_CONTEXT_SNAPSHOT_V1; define immutable DECISION_CONTEXT_ASOF receipt, digest/currentness, exact PG-01 parity and minimum worker projection; never execute PG-01 in process authoring.
steps.guard: READY only front-clean current scope; PARTIAL_READY only independent scope with complete dependency closure; otherwise NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE/REQUIRES_DECISION/BLOCKED. No fabricated READY.

transition_contract.conditional_return: A8 may route only to the step responsible for the specific material missing evidence; do not restart or re-open everything
transition_contract.on_block: Preserve typed blocker, affected scope, authority/evidence/source ref and next resolver; no fake PASS or work outside Analysis
transition_contract.on_decision: Return explicit decision context to SUPER_ADMIN where an actual material product/authority choice is needed; do not auto-approve ADR
transition_contract.on_currentness_change: Rebuild only affected material projections, never silently rebind an immutable as-of snapshot
transition_contract.on_stop: A8 STOP ends research, NOT all blockers and NOT executable handoff readiness

procedure_source_completion: all nine transitions and owners defined
A10-A15 and any live cases deferred

handoff_contract.author: A9
handoff_contract.receiver: PG-01; contract declaration only in this source-only batch
handoff_contract.admission_rule: Only independently READY and front-clean scopes after currentness and exact producer/receiver digest parity; not exercised in this batch
